ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_begin.title: A Wizard Is Never Late
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_begin.desc: At the &6big Barbecue Pit&r in the Guhmension stands a cart full of fireworks. That's &dGuhdalf&r. Talk to him: he's looking for someone with sturdy pawsies for a VERY important little job. The &6grill portal&r to the Guhbarbecuether won't work again until you've helped him, nyeg.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_sam.title: I'm Not Going Without You
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_sam.desc: &dSam-guh&r walks the whole journey with you, with all his pans on his back. Click him: he tells you what to do now and which way to go. Everyone has their own Sam-guh.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_rust.title: Catching Your Breath
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_rust.desc: Along the way you'll find &6rest stops&r: a little camp with a &6Rest Fire&r. Walk up to it and it's your rest stop. If you get spotted or caught, that's where you come back to. You never lose anything. And Sam-guh cooks up a stew, wahoog!
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_om.title: Don't Put It On!
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_om.desc: Right-click with the &6Nibble Ring&r and you put it on. Mikas can't see you anymore... but the &cEye of Sauceron&r sees you very well indeed, and in the Guhbarbecuether the &cNine&r come to fetch you. So take it off again quickly. Or don't, nyeg.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_negen.title: Outrunning the Nine
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_negen.desc: Nine &cSkelly Mika Riders&r. They won't do a thing to you: they only shove you back to your last rest stop. Take the ring off, run away fast or dazzle them with the Light Phial until they've lost you.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_gaven.title: The Gifts of Guhladriel
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_gaven.desc: Three little presents for the road: the &bLight Phial&r (a flash, and a little lamp in your hand), the &aLittle Elven Cloak&r (crouch and stand still: you look like a rock) and the &7Elven Rope&r (pulls you to a hook).
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_rots.title: I'm a Rock, Nyeg
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_rots.desc: With the Little Elven Cloak on you: &6crouch and stand very still&r. The Eye and the riders will look right past you. No sneezing.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_touw.title: Hup, Up You Go
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_touw.desc: Look at an &6Elven Rope Hook&r and right-click with the Elven Rope: it pulls you over, from up to 24 blocks away. After the story you can make hooks yourself and hang them anywhere.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_gedragen.des: At Mount Fry the ring gets heavier and heavier. Then click Sam-guh: &dI can't carry the ring, but I can carry you, nyeg!&r
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_einde.title: Ring-Bearer
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_einde.desc: The Nibble Ring has been fried and shared. You have the title &6Ring-Bearer&r, four outfits (Guhdalf's pointy hat with beard, the elven cloak, hairy hobbit feet and the ring on a chain) and the statuette of the Eye that blinks.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_eigen_sam.de: After the party Sam-guh is still standing next to you. Click him and he's yours forever. One time, only for you.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_maatje.title: Tasty Fishesss
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_maatje.desc: &dSmikagol&r is your buddy now. Put him near water (crouch and click: then he stays put) and he catches fish for you. Lost him? The &6fish bone&r calls him.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_feest.title: There's Always Something to Celebrate
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_feest.desc: In the Nibble Shire it's a party every day now. One &6Party Nibble&r a day, or you'll roll down the hill.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_wegwijs.desc: This way you'll never lose your way: at the &6top left&r it says what to do now, the &dGuhdex&r (Tales tab) holds your &6Journey Map&r, the &6Super Compass&r points to 'My Story' and Sam-guh knows too. The chapters below open one by one.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h1_guhdalf.d: Talk to &dGuhdalf&r at the &6big Barbecue Pit&r in the Guhmension (the Grill Guh's barbecue has to be burning first). He tells you about a nibble in the shape of a ring. And about a party.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h1_klusjes.d: Three little jobs at Guhdalf's cart: launch a &6rocket&r from the crate, set the &6party table&r and invite &dSam-guh&r. Everyone can do this: nothing runs out.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h1_feest.des: Talk to Guhdalf again. The farewell party begins, with a speech, lots of cake and a present: the &6Nibble Ring&r. Don't eat it. Don't put it on. Nyeg.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h1_sam.title: I'm Coming Too!
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h1_sam.desc: Talk to &dSam-guh&r. From now on he walks the whole journey with you, with all his pans on his back.
Pack the provisions: click the three &6Provisions Crates&r by the cart (sausage, cheese and nibbles). Sam-guh has to be nearby to take them.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h1_portaal.d: Walk with Sam-guh to the &6grill portal&r of the Barbecue Pit. That finishes chapter 1 and the portal works again: the Guhbarbecuether awaits!
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h2_reis.desc: You're through the grill portal. Walk with &dSam-guh&r through the Guhbarbecuether to &6Guhvendell&r, the house of Guhrond in the Sausage Woods. You'll know it by the three waterfalls of cheese sauce. The &6Super Compass&r (My Story) shows the way.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h2_guhrond.d: Talk to &dGuhrond&r. He's standing on the doorstep of the big white house. That house is three thousand years old. So is the cheese sauce, nyeg.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h2_gezelscha: Get to know &dAraguh&r (at the gate: he wants to see if you can sneak), &dLeguhlas&r and &dGimguh&r (in the garden, by their pile of nibbles), &dBoromika&r (in the hall) and &dMerry&r and &dPippguh&r (in the kitchen, where else). Watch your bag.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h2_raad.desc: Ring the &6bell&r in the council ring, the round ring of pillars on the far side of the bridge. Then the council begins. Everyone wants to eat the ring. Gimguh even gives it a try.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h2_ringdrage: The council is squabbling. Tell &dGuhrond&r that you will take the Nibble Ring to Mount Fry. You get provisions for the road. And eight companions. Nobody asked for eight.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h2_genootsch: Talk to &dGuhdalf&r when you're ready to leave. After that the journey goes on to the &6Mines of Nibblemoria&r. Guhrond stays living in Guhvendell: you're always welcome back.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h3_reis.desc: Over the mountain won't work, around it takes too long. Walk with Sam-guh to the &6Mines of Nibblemoria&r: the &dSuper Compass&r (My Story) shows the way, quite a walk from Guhvendell. Until you get there, all you'll see is Guhdalf's smoke.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h3_poort.des: The gate is shut tight and Guhdalf is out of ideas too. Above the door glows a spell. Read it &6very literally&r and type the word in chat. (Or click the glowing runes and pick the right answer.)
Four levers, each under a sign. On the stone in the middle is a little rhyme about how a dwarf guh eats: pull the levers in &6that order&r. One wrong lever and everything jumps back. Everyone solves this riddle for themselves.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h3_put.title: Fool of a Pippguh
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h3_put.desc: Through the portcullis lies an old guard room with a well. Pippguh spots a little bucket sitting on the edge. &cNobody touches that bucket.&r Nyeg.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h3_gang.desc: The corridor has caved in and the drums are coming closer. Talk to &dGimguh&r: there's a dwarf door in the wall. Knock &6three times&r on the rune of what Durguh liked best to eat. His tomb is in the very same room...
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h3_brug.desc: In the Hall of Pillars something wakes up: the &cBarbecuerog&r, a demon of charcoal and fire. He won't do a thing to you (at most he puts you back at your rest fire), but &6run&r: across the &6Crumble Path&r, which drops away under your pawsies, and the narrow &6Bridge of Nibble-dûm&r. On the other side... just watch.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h3_njeg.desc: You said the word out loud in chat, just as it's written. It took Guhdalf three spells.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h3_val.title: A Quick Trip into the Deep
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h3_val.desc: The Crumble Path holds out exactly long enough. Usually. If you fall, you're right back at your rest fire: you don't lose a thing.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h3_zweep.des: The Barbecuerog's whip is a row of little bratwursts knotted together. You'll notice when he catches you with it. You smell like barbecue for an hour afterwards.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h3_buiten.de: Guhdalf has fallen. Climb the &6long stairs&r to the East Gate and talk to &dAraguh&r outside. Gimguh chipped four more &6runestones&r out of the wall for you: knock on one for a different sign. You can watch the scenes again in the &dGuhdex&r.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h4_woud.desc: After the mine the &6Super Compass&r ('My Story') points to &dGuhlórien&r, where the satay trees turn gold. Walk to the gate of the tree city &6Caras Guhladhon&r. As soon as you're there, Guhdalf's Veil opens for you.
At the gate stands &dLeguhlas&r. He saw you coming days ago and has an opinion about it. Talk to him.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h4_guhladrie: Climb the big spiral staircase around the &6Great Skewer&r, all the way up to the hall under the crown. That's where &dGuhladriel&r sits. She knows everything already, but have a little chat with her anyway. Falling doesn't hurt in her city.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h4_rust.desc: On the &6guest platform&r (the tree by the gate) a &6Rest Fire&r is burning and there are sleeping bags. Snuggle in. This is your rest stop right away.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h4_spiegel.d: In the middle of the night Guhladriel walks to the green dell. Right-click the &bMirror&r and see what was, what is, and what has yet to be baked. Don't be startled by the Eye: he's only a tiny bit hungry.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h4_gaven.des: Talk to Guhladriel at the mirror. You get the &bLight Phial&r, the &aLittle Elven Cloak&r and the &7Elven Rope&r. You'll really need them further on. Lost one? Guhladriel gives you a new one.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h4_vaart.des: At the dock, hop into Leguhlas's &6Elven Boat&r (click the boat or him). It sails down the &dGuhduin&r all by itself, past the two giant statues of the &6Arguhnath&r. Stay comfy in your seat and look up.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h5_ring_h5_1: At the Edge of Ash Vale
The journey goes on to &6Ash Vale&r. Your Super Compass ('My Story') and Sam-guh show the way to the camp in front of the &cBlack Grill Gate&r. A rest fire is burning there.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h5_ring_h5_2: By the fire sits &dBoromika&r, a Mika who REALLY wants to help. Talk to him. He does stare at your ring for an awfully long time, though...
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h5_ring_h5_3: We Swears It on the Chonkie

Something is rustling by the provisions. It's &dSmikagol&r, a skinny Mika who has lost his 'chonkie'. He knows a sneak path past the Eye. Click him and let him show the way. Sam-guh wouldn't trust him with a single nibble.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h5_ring_h5_4: Follow Smikagol up the ridge. Up there you see it for the first time: the gate, the tower and the &cEye&r. His gaze is a &6patch of light on the ground&r. That's where he's looking.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h5_ring_h5_5: Cross the &6Ash Field&r. The light of the Eye sweeps back and forth: wait behind a little wall or under a little roof until it has passed, then run to the next one. Spotted? Then you're back at your last rest fire. You don't lose a thing.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h5_ring_h5_6: On the &6Bare Plain&r there's nothing to sit behind. With the &aLittle Elven Cloak&r on you: &6crouch and stand still&r when the light comes your way. The Eye thinks rocks are boring.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h5_ring_h5_7: Under the wall the Eye isn't looking. But there's &7smoke&r hanging about (let the &bLight Phial&r flash: poof, gone) and two riders of the &cNine&r are riding by. A flash dazzles them, and they ride right past a rock.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h5_ring_h5_8: Three &cGrill Guards&r at the Guard Fence. Mikas can't see a ring-bearer: put the &6Nibble Ring&r on at the skull post, walk through the fence and take it off again &6right away&r. The Eye feels the ring, and the Nine smell it.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h5_ring_h5_9: The &6Little Grill Door&r is locked and the Nine are coming. But look who's standing up there on the wall...
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h5_ring_h5_1: Through the little door, down the tunnel under the wall. You've sneaked past the Eye of Sauceron, wahoog! Sam-guh gives you two stews for the climb: now there's only &cMount Fry&r left.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h6_kamp.desc: Beyond the Black Grill Gate the &6Smoke Delta&r begins. In the middle of the fumes stands &cMount Fry&r. Walk with Sam-guh to the &6Base Camp&r on the south side and warm up by the Rest Fire. The Super Compass shows the way (My Story).
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h6_pad.title: The Winding Path
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h6_pad.desc: Behind the gate the &6Winding Path&r twists around the mountain. The mountain throws &cembers&r: they don't hurt, they only shove you. On the First Ledge a &dSmoke Guhling&r sits in a cage: the Mikas are using it as a range hood! Click the lock.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h6_touw.desc: The path has caved in. Look up: under every &6hook&r hangs a little blue lamp. Right-click with the &7Elven Rope&r and you get pulled up. Two hooks further on sits the second Smoke Guhling. And Smikagol is grabbing at your ring: &bflash him away&r with the Light Phial.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h6_zwaar.des: The higher you go, the heavier the ring. Follow the narrow path to the east side, take the last hook and free the third Smoke Guhling. Falling is no trouble at all: you come back at your last Rest Fire.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h6_sam.title: But I Can Carry You
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h6_sam.desc: The ring now weighs as much as a whole cheese shop. Click &dSam-guh&r. &dI can't carry the ring... but I can carry you, nyeg!&r He lugs you up the last stretch, to the Crack of Fry.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h6_frituur.t: One Nibble to Share Them All
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h6_frituur.d: Walk through the crack to the &6Frying Edge&r above the fryer. What happens there, you have to see for yourself. After that the Smoke Guhs bring you home.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h6_feest.des: Back in the &aNibble Shire&r everyone is waiting for you. Araguh gets a crown of nibbles, Pippguh wants a second dessert, and you get the title &6Ring-Bearer&r and everything that comes with it.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_h6_flits.des: When Smikagol grabs at the ring on the mountain, use the &bLight Phial&r. He'll keep his pawsies to himself for a good long while.
All three Smoke Guhlings are free. Remember them well: you'll see them again when the mountain starts to bubble.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_sausuman_tor: A Black Tower Full of Smoke

Not far from Guhladriel's tree city a black tower stands sputtering. That's the home of &6Sauceruman of Many Sauces&r, a wizard Mika who wants a bite of the ring too. Your &dSuper Compass&r knows the way (Barbecue tab). You don't need it for the journey, but it does smell yummy there, nyeg.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_sausuman_ing: Sauceruman isn't getting a bite, so he's baking a ring of his own. Fetch for his &6Ring Baker&r: &6ring dough&r from the Dough Kneader (one floor up), &6hot frying sauce&r from the Sauce Tap (two floors up) and &6cheese&r from the Cheese Cupboard (three floors up). Only, that cupboard is a little bit empty.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_sausuman_bak: One Ring to Eat Them All
Got everything? Then pull the lever of the &6Ring Baker&r, down in the hall. Stand back: it rumbles, it sputters, it shakes... DING!
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_sausuman_mok: It turned out to be an &6onion ring&r. Sauceruman wanted cheese, this is a vegetable, so now he's sitting in his Sulking Corner. Offer him a bite. You get the &6Pannantír&r, a handful of onion rings, and from now on the Ring Baker bakes you an onion ring every day.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_sausuman_te_: Take a look at the machines in the hall: &cToo heavy: there's not enough chonk power, so everything stands still&r. Sauceruman hooked five real machines up to a single &6Mika Wheel&r, and a Mika does not run. Go on, give the Mika a poke (right-click the wheel). So that's how NOT to do it. How to do it right is under &bGuh Technology&r: a Guh Wheel, with a guh in it.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_sausuman_pan: At the top of the tower stands a pan you can see things in. Have a look inside (right-click). Mostly you see an eye that's feeling hungry. Afterwards you get to take one home yourself.
ftb.guhs_knabbelring.q.ring_sausuman_dag: Even when Sauceruman is sulking, the &6Ring Baker&r still works: pull the lever and you get one &6onion ring&r a day. He isn't looking. He never looks.
